success.description: Always true when a query was generated.

spl_query.description:
Raw SPL query — no markdown, no backticks, no comments. Use
for line breaks between pipeline stages. A single end-to-end SPL pipeline (a Splunk ES correlation search is one query, not a list).

message.description: Short human-readable summary of what the query detects and which MITRE technique(s) and data source(s) it relies on.
